messages.content: James spends 10 minutes to get through 3 pages of his book as part of his bedtime routine. If he completes 18 pages before he chooses to sleep, how many minutes does he dedicate to reading?

content.text:
# Solving James's Reading Time

## Setting Up the Problem

I need to find the total minutes James spends reading, given:
- **Rate:** 10 minutes per 3 pages
- **Total pages read:** 18 pages

## Finding the Rate per Page

$$\frac{10 \text{ minutes}}{3 \text{ pages}} = \frac{10}{3} \text{ minutes per page}$$

## Calculating Total Time

$$18 \text{ pages} \times \frac{10}{3} \text{ minutes per page} = \frac{180}{3} = 60 \text{ minutes}$$

## Answer

James dedicates **60 minutes** (1 hour) to reading before bed.
